surfaces.cart.page: The WooCommerce cart page and links to it.
surfaces.checkout.steps: Checkout step and substep titles and the step counter.
surfaces.checkout.step-form: The checkout step form area (contact fields, guest text, opt-ins).
surfaces.checkout.order-summary: The checkout order summary panel, coupon and free shipping bar.
surfaces.checkout.trust: Trust section (payment logos, secure payments text) on checkout.
surfaces.checkout.gift-card-compat: Coupon validation order between gift cards and smart coupons at checkout.
surfaces.drawer.cart.icon: Heading icon of the off-canvas mini cart drawer.
surfaces.drawer.cart.empty: Empty state of the off-canvas mini cart drawer.
surfaces.drawer.wishlist.icon: Heading icon of the off-canvas wishlist drawer.
surfaces.drawer.wishlist.card: Product card used in the wishlist drawer and its suggested row.
surfaces.pdp.summary.after-atc: Area directly after the add to cart button on the product page.
surfaces.pdp.recently-viewed: Recently viewed products section on the product page.
surfaces.header.search: Header search and its suggestion dropdown.
surfaces.archive.sorting: Sorting dropdown and label on product archives.
surfaces.woocommerce.core-hooks: Reusable WooCommerce filters and actions loaded with WooCommerce.
surfaces.perf.async-styles: Non-blocking load of non-critical plugin stylesheets.
surfaces.perf.critical-css-supplements: Inline first-paint CSS that survives unused-CSS removal.
surfaces.perf.dequeue-assets: Removal of stylesheets and scripts the page never uses.
surfaces.perf.fonts-critical-path: Inline local Google Fonts CSS and fallback faces.
surfaces.perf.hero-facade: Poster-first homepage hero for video embeds.
surfaces.perf.lazy-rescan: Lazy image rescan after AJAX content swaps.
surfaces.perf.lcp-image: Never-lazy and preload for the LCP image.
surfaces.perf.media-hygiene: Image and embed corrections that stop over-downloading.
surfaces.perf.minicart-hydrate: Deferred mini cart suggestions and cart-fragments seeding.
